summary: Applies parametric EQ bands with controllable frequency and bandwidth for more targeted audio filtering than fixed graphic EQ bands.
key_concepts: Audio Para EQ CHOP applies up to three parametric filters to incoming audio.
The three filters are evaluated in series, so later filters process the output of earlier filters.
Each enabled filter has center frequency, bandwidth, and boost controls.
Boost is measured in dB, with positive values making audio around the center frequency louder and negative values making it quieter.
Frequency-modulation inputs can drive fast center-frequency changes at CHOP sample rates to avoid audible stepping.

key_params.name: drywet
key_params.note: Blend filtered output with the dry input

common_gotchas: Use Audio Para EQ when center frequency and bandwidth matter; use Audio Band EQ for fixed graphic bands.
Bandwidth values interact with frequency and can make broad tonal changes or narrow resonant cuts.
Frequency controls should be kept inside the useful range for the input sample rate.
Multiple active bands can compound gain and clip downstream output.
